supersededReason: A3-PRIMARY-002 was declared failed and hash-sealed before any sealed response content was inspected. Its fail-closed audit exposed two benchmark defects: suite 0.3.3 defined no unsupported_claim_avoidance component, and the phase auditor rejected the intentional single execution phase emitted by maximum-context Writer runs even though that phase exactly reconciled to total usage. After the failure declaration, inspection was limited to the five response records implicated by failed candidate safety checks. All five were deterministic-scorer false negatives: two correct countdown diagnoses used equivalent eight-day language, and three correct intentional-control diagnoses used explicit no-error, does-not-require, resolved, or consistent language outside the frozen regex. Suite 0.3.4 changes only versioned deterministic scoring metadata, provides exactly one unsupported-claim component per task, and broadens those two semantic patterns. Evaluation commit 173edd6167c99715133e8e8af5b87af0e82fdec2 adds fail-closed scoring-only resume validation, exact trial reruns, and correct maximum-context phase reconciliation. Model-visible prompts, contexts, criteria, authority, candidate behavior, targets, model settings, gates, and human-review selection are unchanged.
sealedResponseContentInspectedAfterFailu: Only the five records implicated by failed candidate safety checks; no other sealed response content was inspected.

model.seedPolicy: No provider seed is supplied because DeepSeek V4 Pro does not expose a supported deterministic seed in this path. Trial index and all outputs remain recorded.

targets.receiptMethod: SHA-256 of exact Git blob bytes at evaluationCommit, read with git cat-file blob <commit>:<path>
targets.stockOpenCodeProtocol: Create a fresh Git repository containing only plain bounded chapter files with stable passage comments; send the public author request and authority but no manuscript body, benchmark material, Writer contract, gold, checks, or narrative tools in the prompt; capture passage, file, marker, and HEAD mutations as edit artifacts; delete the workspace after the cell.

rawModelPricing.telemetryRequirement: Every accepted raw-model response must record provider prompt_cache_hit_tokens and prompt_cache_miss_tokens; absence fails the cell.

resume.rule: The runner must prove that every model-visible task field and every judge criterion is identical after normalizing suiteVersion. It then deterministically rescores all 537 successful responses under suite 0.3.4 and replaces only the three exact failed trials. Successful sibling trials may not be replaced.

unsupportedClaimMetric.intentionalControls: The intentional-control check measures whether the response avoids inventing a contradiction where the manuscript defines a compatible, resolved, or deliberately non-erroneous state.
unsupportedClaimMetric.otherTasks: A citation-level unsupported-claim check rejects cited evidence outside the admitted context packet. It intentionally duplicates the grounding predicate under a separately preregistered metric so the previously missing gate is computable on every task.
unsupportedClaimMetric.limitation: This deterministic proxy does not establish that every uncited prose statement is supported; that remains a reported limitation and a future benchmark-design requirement.

executionRule: Run both tracks from the frozen candidate source and revision-6 task receipts. Preserve A3-PRIMARY-002 as failed evidence. The scoring-only recovery is a separate immutable attempt and may make only the three named provider calls. Do not alter candidate code, prompts, context policy, criteria, targets, model settings, gates, or human-review selection. Any further failure requires another declared attempt and a new preregistered disposition.
